task: Implementation verification of ASTRA-CAM-001 correction, not a new peer-review round

verified_findings.trigger: Compact synthetic Control contents, camera min 574x288 DIP, 2200->1400 client DIP at unchanged 520-DIP frame client height; no AMS; private native wxGTK scroller.
verified_findings.outcome_old: At 96 DPI / GDK_SCALE=1, actual client width 1385 but virtual width remains 2185, Control minimum 1581. Same excess persists after an extra queued fit; stable, no idle fit callbacks.
verified_findings.outcome_candidate: Virtual width becomes 1385, Control minimum 781. At requested width1000, actual client985 retains required virtual1218. All six compact scale/DPI pairs reproduce the old fixed point and pass correction checks.
verified_findings.smallest_practical_fix: Already present in candidate: client width minus exact three spacer widths, bounded by natural minima; FitInside after changed sizing. No further source change suggested by this test.
verification_still_needed: Native Cocoa/MSW rendering and integration behavior, if those claims are needed.
Full application controls, media events/fullscreen lifecycle, WebView readiness/content-report timing are outside the disconnected fixture.
limits: GTK3 private Xvfb native scrollers/sizers; not Cocoa/MSW rendering.
Media is a plain panel returning invalid video size, exercising production 16:9 fallback.
Other content/header/progress minima are fixed synthetic fixtures; no claim those heights were measured in the app.
AMS is synthetic native panel; fixed 340 DIP page content; no WebView, readiness, network, device or report timing test.
Geometry stability means unchanged geometry and no size/fit callbacks during 200ms quiet window after 300ms settlement; not a claim of zero idle events.
Tall and compact synthetic content profiles intentionally differ and are reported separately.
